objective: Tranche 1 Qualification: Native Zig Engine socket probe fix, CLI dispatcher integration, and full multi-suite test qualification.

steps.name: daemon-socket-probe-fix
steps.detail: Calix.Cli.Zig/src/daemon/server.zig: isServing() replaced std.Io.net.UnixAddress.connect with direct posix socket and connect probes, preventing unexpected errno 111 (ECONNREFUSED) panic on stale or absent sockets.

steps.name: native-zig-build-and-test
steps.detail: Rebuilt Calix.Cli.Zig (ReleaseSafe) using pinned Zig 0.16.0 compiler. Executed full test suite: 21/21 steps succeeded, 392/392 tests passed.

steps.name: gpui-frontend-test-suite
steps.detail: Ran cargo test on Calix.Ui.Gpui: 266/266 unit and integration tests passed cleanly.

steps.name: cli-dispatcher-integration
steps.detail: scripts/calix: Added inventory subcommand and automatic native engine fallback for native commands (search, run, install, etc.) pointing to zig-out/bin/calix or /usr/lib/calix/calix.

steps.name: native-inventory-verification
steps.detail: Verified calix inventory emits full unified inventory JSON without invoking Python runtime. Contains 1773 ALPM, 20 AUR, 15 AppImage, 20 Cargo, 9 NPM, and 1 Release (artcraft-launcher 0.8.1).

steps.name: system-sync-verification
steps.detail: calix sync --runtime executed cleanly in 1571ms, publishing state to ~/.local/state/calix/status.json and updating ~/.config/calix/appimage-metadata-v2.db.

steps.name: system-health-audit
steps.detail: calix health verified: pacman DB lock free, cachy-update inactive, calix-sync.timer active (waiting).

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Calix.Cli.Zig/src/daemon/server.zig isServing() panicked with unexpected errno: 111 (ECONNREFUSED) when probing dead unix domain sockets because std.Io in Zig 0.16 lacks .CONNREFUSED in netConnectUnixPosix.
defects_found_and_fixed.caught_by: zig build test failure in test.isServing
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Replaced high-level connect with raw std.posix.system.socket and std.posix.system.connect checking connect_rc == 0.

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: calix CLI dispatcher did not expose inventory or forward native commands to the compiled Zig binary.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Added inventory subcommand and native fallback loop in scripts/calix.
